name: Aisai [Reverse Side]
source:
Protagonist Tatsuya is a newly married company man living meager but happy every day with his beautiful bride Misaki.

In the summer while Tatsuya is away on business, Misaki allows a job-hunting relative to stay. Tatsuya has a poor impression of the boy and were he there to object, he would.

The brat relative immediately starts telling lies to Misaki. "Tatsuya teases me. Tatsuya is having an affair..... and I have truly fallen in love with you."

Send your piercing impatience to a place of boundless, flavorful passion! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE061222.html]DLsite English[/url]]
